senses.gloss: जैमन्त जैमन्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.

जैमन्तायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Jai-
manta.

जैमिनि जैमिनि, इस्, m., N. of a celebrated
saint and philosopher, the pupil of Vyāsa and founder
of the Pūrva (or Karma) Mimāṃsā school. He is said
[]
to have acted as Udgātṛ at the sacrifice of Janam-
ejaya (Mahā-bh. I. 2046), and to have received
the Sāma-veda from Vyāsa.

जैमिनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to Jaimini; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a school of the Sāma-veda.

जैमूत जैमूत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जीमूत), relating
to Jīmūta.
